Select IC50 activity rows for human Metabotropic glutamate receptor 5 (CHEMBL3227). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then assays on assay_id, then target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN to enforce presence of canonical SMILES. Join docs on doc_id to obtain PubMed ID or DOI. Join compound_records on record_id to retrieve compound key. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL3227 and standard_type IC50, requiring canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL and (pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR doi IS NOT NULL). Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
